description_en: Queries the vulnerability prevention statistics of a Security Center user
description_zh: 查询云安全中心用户漏洞防御统计
name: DescribeVulDefendCountStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The type of vulnerability to query. Valid values:

app: application vulnerability
emg: emergency vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞类型。取值：

app：应用漏洞
emg：应急漏洞
parameters.name: vul_type

RaspDefendedCount.description_en: The number of vulnerabilities that have been defended against

RaspDefensibleCount.description_en: The number of vulnerabilities that can be defended against

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. China Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
